activity_summary: You ate at threepence. The loaf was a penny and a finger and a half short. You said you had been an old man of the house, not the lover, and off before the end. Susanna is still eleven. The letter is not written. The thimble is on the road. You did not open the king.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, named the part, and left the letter unwritten.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Priced the board and the loaf, and refused the letter as tonight's work.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked whether he had been the lover, and left the horn.
